findings.evidence: Lines 98–125 concern only chartAt, the orbit projection, and an arbitrary F; their proofs use exists_symm_eq_addQuotientMk_of_mem_atlas_addQuotient and chart identities.

summary: The interface hides reusable quotient-chart infrastructure and lacks characteristic membership and simplification lemmas.
